title: Recall: Optional parsing
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

parse.clue: Inside a function returning Result<u32, ParseIntError>, given text: &str, write the expression parsing an unsigned 32-bit integer using a turbofish and propagating a parse error with ?.

absent.clue: Matching Option<&str> inside a function returning Result<Option<u32>, ParseIntError>, write the complete missing-input arm returning successful absence. Omit the comma.
